meta.title: Z - Successfully Hired - Rockstar Virtual Assistant

sections.heading: About Orion Brands
sections.content:
Orion Brands is a fast-growing, US-based baby essentials company best known for its top quality modern baby nursery bedding that have satisfied and served hundreds of thousands of parents since 2016.
At the center of our success is our mad obsession for serving our community of first time parents.
We are a family owned business on a mission to celebrate parenthood with our community of super moms and dads by creating beautiful and easy to use products that brings joy in their tough lives and keeps their little humans safe in utmost comfort.
We're changing how quality baby products make parenting easy and enjoyable. As one of our early hires, you will help us deliver this promise.

sections.heading: Job Description:
sections.content: We are looking for an enthusiastic and resourceful Virtual Assistant to join our growing team. As our Rockstar Virtual Assistant you will be in a position to grow your skills and make an immediate impact on our fast growing business.

sections.heading: Must Have Qualities:
sections.content:
You must be extremly good in conversational English so you can communicate with our customers who we obssess about
Good comprehension and writing skills
Comfortable with Excel and working with data
Self starter with a killer "Get Stuff Done" attitude.
A problem-sovler not a problem-presenter
Excellent research and reporting skills

sections.heading: Ideal Qualities:
sections.content:
Customer support experience
Inventory management or supply chain management experience
Hands on experieince with Amazon Seller Central
Excitement about helping people start and grow businesses that change the world

sections.heading: What You'll Do:
sections.content:
Obsessing with customers, replying to their complaints and questions
Helping manage and maintain our inventories at warehouses
Organizing reports and COGS for inventory and financials
Monitoring and maintaining health of our accounts on online sales channels like Amazon
Assisting our Sales & Marketing team with updating product details on online product pages
Assisting me (owner) with variety of research based tasks
Learning from one of the customer obsessed baby goods brand in America on how to deliver the promise of happiness.
In the form, in place of website, please enter your onlinejobs.ph link

sections.heading: Salary & Benefits:
sections.content:
Work from home
Competitive pay, upto $800/month
Yearly bonus
Hands on Training
Full on support and feedback from me
A chance to grow your skills, experience and to do what you truly love doing!
Work in an amzing culture where we support and care for each other
